<translate>
<!--T:5-->
'''Martial Artist''' is the technical striker among the [[Special:MyLanguage/Classes|classes]]. It has the best Strike Power scaling, a sturdy Vitality scaling, and a passive that makes its strike attacks hit harder as the target's health drops.
</translate>

<translate>
== Passive: Executioner Strikes == <!--T:6-->

<!--T:7-->
'''Strike''' attacks deal up to '''+25%''' damage based on the '''target's''' missing health:

<!--T:8-->
* no bonus while the target is above '''75%''' health;
* the bonus rises as its health drops, up to the full '''+25%''' at '''25%''' health or below.

<!--T:9-->
It is great for finishing weakened foes. See [[Special:MyLanguage/Strike Attacks|Strike Attacks]] for the techniques it applies to.
</translate>

<translate>
== Starting stats and regeneration == <!--T:10-->

<!--T:11-->
* '''Starting stats:''' SKP 10 · VIT 10
* '''Regeneration''' (per 5 seconds): health 1.5 (+0.0525 per VIT) · Ki 4.0 (+0.08 per ENE) · stamina 9.0 (+0.03375 per VIT, +0.045 per RES)
</translate>

<translate>
== Stat scaling == <!--T:12-->

<!--T:13-->
The Martial Artist's standout scalings are '''Strike Power''' (1.8) and '''Vitality''' (2.2). The VIT and DEF values grow on a curve as you invest more, up to 4 times the starting rate. Compare every class on the [[Special:MyLanguage/Classes#Default stat scalings|Classes]] page.
</translate>

<translate>
== Configuration == <!--T:14-->
</translate>
{{Config|Custom Races|stats.json}}
<translate>
<!--T:15-->
The class id is <code>martialartist</code>. Its passive values are <code>maxBonus</code> (0.25), <code>hpHigh</code> (0.75) and <code>hpLow</code> (0.25), set per race in <code>races/&lt;race&gt;/stats.json</code> together with the starting stats, scalings and regeneration.
</translate>
